```{r}
#loading packages and cleaning data

library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(purrr)
library(tidyr)
library(lme4)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)

files_path <- "datasets/G_lists_dataset"

csv_files <- list.files(path = files_path, pattern = "*.csv", full.names = TRUE)

combined_data <- csv_files %>%
  map_dfr(~ read_delim(.x, delim = ";"))

```


```{r}
#diachronic analysis

#filtering out only ON a and e class verbs
combined_data <- combined_data %>%
  filter(Hist_status %in% c("a", "e"))


#i will only look into lexemes that have undergone a>a, a>e, e>a, e>e

combined_data <- combined_data %>%
  mutate(Shift_status = as.character(Shift_status))

lexemes_to_keep <- combined_data %>%
  filter(
    Cell == "inf",
    !is.na(Shift_status),
    Shift_status %in% c("a>a", "a>e", "e>a", "e>e")
  ) %>%
  pull(Lexeme) %>%
  unique()


# Keep all rows for those lexemes
combined_data <- combined_data %>%
  filter(
    Lexeme %in% lexemes_to_keep,
    !is.na(Shift_status),
    Shift_status %in% c("a>a", "a>e", "e>a", "e>e")
  )


#keeping only relevant stem shapes (deleting double stem shapes and V:)
combined_data <- combined_data %>%
  filter(Stem_type %in% c("V:C", "VC", "VCC"))


```



```{r}
#EDA

#plotting shift no shift for ON a class verbs 

#making an order in which dialects will appear in visualizations, some characters are unrecognized, therefore using numeric indexes here

dialects <- sort(unique(combined_data$Dialect))
dials_df <- data.frame(ix = seq_along(dialects), dialect = dialects, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
print(dials_df)

chosen_index_order <- c(2,3,12,5,7,15,13,1,4,6,9,14,16,11,18,8,10,17)

my_order <- dialects[chosen_index_order]

combined_data <- combined_data %>% mutate(Dialect_ordered = factor(Dialect, levels = my_order))

subset_ONa <- combined_data %>%
  filter(Shift_status %in% c("a>a", "a>e"), !is.na(Shift_status))


#counts, used in descriptive results
counts_by_dialect_A <- subset_ONa %>%
  group_by(Dialect_area, Dialect, Shift_status) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")

props_by_dialect_A <- counts_by_dialect_A %>%
  group_by(Dialect_area, Dialect) %>%
  mutate(
    total = sum(n),
    prop = n / total
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

props_by_dialect_A

props_by_area_A <- subset_ONa %>%
  group_by(Dialect_area, Shift_status) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Dialect_area) %>%
  mutate(
    total = sum(n),
    prop  = n / total
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

props_by_area_A

#visualization

ggplot(subset_ONa, aes(x = Dialect_ordered, fill = Shift_status)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill", width = 0.7, colour = "black") +
  facet_wrap(~ Dialect_area, scales = "free_x", strip.position = "bottom", labeller = labeller(Dialect_area = c(
      "East" = "East Nw",
      "Northwestern"   = "Northwestern Nw",
      "Southern"  = "Southern Nw",
      "Southwestern" = "Southwestern Nw"))
      ) +
  geom_text(
    stat = "count",
    aes(label = ..count..),
    position = position_fill(vjust = 0.5),
    size = 3,
    color = "white"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("a>a" = "#BDBDBD", "a>e" = "#2F2F2F")) +
  labs(x = "Dialect area and dialect point", y = "Percentage of paradigms", fill = "Shift status") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  theme_classic() +                                     
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 10),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```

```{r}
#paradigmatic configs of the shifted verbs

#this one is for ON a class verbs
pattern_summary_A <- subset_ONa %>%
  filter(Shift_status == "a>e") %>%
  group_by(Pattern) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n)) %>%
  mutate(
    pct = n / sum(n) * 100
  )

pattern_summary_A


ggplot(pattern_summary_A,
       aes(x = reorder(Pattern, -pct), y = pct)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#BDBDBD", colour = "black", size = 0.4) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n),
            vjust = -0.3, colour = "black", size = 4) +
  labs(
    x = "Configuration",
    y = "Percentage of paradigms"
  ) +
  ylim(0, max(pattern_summary_A$pct) * 1.15) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 14)
  )
```

```{r}
#fitting models, fiting two separate models for a-class and e-class verbs, as different factors may be at work in different ways

#ON a-class verbs first
#keeping only relevant data (a>e and a>a) and coding 0 1
data_model_A <- combined_data %>%
  filter(Shift_status %in% c("a>e", "a>a")) %>%
  mutate(outcome = ifelse(Shift_status == "a>a", 0, 1))

#transforming token frequency
data_model_A <- data_model_A %>%
  mutate(log_freq = log(Token_fr + 1))

 
#Mixed effects model with fixed predictors and random effects for overall data

model_A <- glmer(outcome ~ Stem_type + TD_nonTD + log_freq + Dialect_area + (1 | Dialect) + (1 | Lexeme),
               data = data_model_A,
               family = binomial,
               control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                      optCtrl = list(maxfun = 1e5)))
summary(model_A)


#now ON e class verbs
#keeping only relevant data (e>e and e>a) and coding 0 1
data_model_E <- combined_data %>%
  filter(Shift_status %in% c("e>e", "e>a")) %>%
  mutate(outcome = ifelse(Shift_status == "e>e", 0, 1))

#transforming token frequency, log, and scaling
data_model_E <- data_model_E %>%
  mutate(log_freq = log(Token_fr + 1))

 
#Mixed effects model with fixed predictors and random effects for overall data

model_E <- glmer(outcome ~ Stem_type + TD_nonTD + log_freq + Dialect_area + (1 | Dialect) + (1 | Lexeme),
               data = data_model_E,
               family = binomial,
               control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                      optCtrl = list(maxfun = 1e5)))
summary(model_E)

```


```{r}
#this is part II - synchronic membership. Here I look into pure a, e and mixed classes

folder_path <- "C:/Users/emilijtr/OneDrive - Universitetet i Oslo/Skrivebord/mixed class and complexity/IC_shifts"

list_of_files <- list.files(path = folder_path, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)


combined_data_synchronic <- list_of_files %>%
  lapply(function(f) read_delim(f, delim = ";") %>% mutate(dialect_file = basename(f))) %>%
  bind_rows()


dialects <- sort(unique(combined_data_synchronic$Dialect))
dials_df <- data.frame(ix = seq_along(dialects), dialect = dialects, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
print(dials_df)

chosen_index_order <- c(2,3,12,5,7,15,13,1,4,6,9,14,16,11,18,8,10,17)

my_order <- dialects[chosen_index_order]

combined_data_synchronic <- combined_data_synchronic %>% mutate(Dialect_ordered = factor(Dialect, levels = my_order))


#keeping only relevant stem shapes (deleting double stem shapes and V:)
combined_data_synchronic <- combined_data_synchronic %>%
  filter(Stem_type %in% c("V:C", "VC", "VCC"))

#keeping only the ones that have a class label (thereby keeping only pure a, pure e or mixed and excluding any other combinations)

combined_data_synchronic <- combined_data_synchronic %>%
  filter(Class_label %in% c("a", "e", "hybrid"))
```

```{r}
    "VCC" = expression(VC[1]*C[2])
  )) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +                                     
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 14),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

#stem-final cons

stem_final_classes_synchronic <- combined_data_synchronic %>%
  filter(Class_label %in% c("a", "e", "hybrid")) %>%
  mutate(TD_nonTD = as.factor(TD_nonTD),
         Class_label = factor(Class_label, levels = c("a", "e", "hybrid")))

stem_final_summary_mixed <- stem_final_classes_synchronic %>%
  count(TD_nonTD, Class_label, name = "n") %>%
  group_by(TD_nonTD) %>%
  mutate(
    prop = n / sum(n),          # proportion 0–1
    pct  = round(prop * 100, 1) # percentage with one decimal
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

stem_final_summary_mixed

ggplot(stem_final_classes_synchronic, aes(x = TD_nonTD, fill = Class_label)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill", width = 0.6, colour = "black") +
   scale_x_discrete(
    labels = c("TD" = "t/d",
               "non" = "non t/d")
  ) +
  geom_text(
    stat = "count",
    aes(label = ..count..),
    position = position_fill(vjust = 0.5),
    size = 4,
    color = "white"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
  values = c("a" = "#BDBDBD", "e" = "#2F2F2F", "hybrid" = "#0072B2"),
  labels = c("a" = "\"pure\" a", "e" = "\"pure\" e", "hybrid" = "mixed")
) +
  labs(x = "Stem-final consonant", y = "Percentage of paradigms", fill = "Class category") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +                                     
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 14),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

#frequencies by class

ggplot(combined_data_synchronic, aes(x = Class_label, y = Token_fr, fill = Class_label)) +
  geom_violin(trim = TRUE, alpha = 0.6, color = NA) +

ggplot(combined_data_synchronic, aes(x = Class_label, y = Token_fr, fill = Class_label)) +
```

```{r}
#fitting models to predict classes

#compute a_nota, e_note, hybrid_nothybrid and then compare 

combined_data_synchronic <- combined_data_synchronic %>%
  mutate(log_frequency = log(Token_fr + 1))

# a vs not_a (not_a = e + hybrid)
df_a <- combined_data_synchronic %>%
  filter(Class_label %in% c("a", "e", "hybrid")) %>%  
  mutate(label = ifelse(Class_label == "a", "a", "nota"),
         y = as.integer(label == "a")) %>%
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = c("nota", "a")))

# e vs not_e (not_e = a + hybrid)
df_e <- combined_data_synchronic %>%
  filter(Class_label %in% c("a", "e", "hybrid")) %>%
  mutate(label = ifelse(Class_label == "e", "e", "note"),
         y = as.integer(label == "e")) %>%
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = c("note", "e")))

# hybrid vs not_H (not_H = a + e)
df_hybrid <- combined_data_synchronic %>%
  filter(Class_label %in% c("a", "e", "hybrid")) %>%
  mutate(label = ifelse(Class_label == "hybrid", "hybrid", "not_H"),
         y = as.integer(label == "hybrid")) %>%
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = c("not_H", "hybrid")))




# Model 1: a_not_a
model_a_not_a <- glmer(y ~ Stem_type + TD_nonTD + log_frequency + Dialect_area +
                (1 | Dialect) + (1 | Lexeme),
                data = df_a,
             family = binomial,
             control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 1e5)))

summary(model_a_not_a)

# Model 2: e_not_E

model_e_not_e <- glmer(y ~ Stem_type + TD_nonTD + log_frequency + Dialect_area +
                (1 | Dialect) + (1 | Lexeme),
                data = df_e,
             family = binomial,
             control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 1e5)))

summary(model_e_not_e)

# Model 3: hybrid not hybrid
model_hybrid <- glmer(y ~ Stem_type + TD_nonTD + log_frequency + Dialect_area +
                (1 | Dialect) + (1 | Lexeme),
                data = df_hybrid, family = binomial,
             control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 1e5)))
summary(model_hybrid)
```


```{r}
#the additional analysis of token fr effects (discussion section)

data_model_all <- combined_data %>%
  filter(Shift_status %in% c("a>a", "a>e", "e>e", "e>a")) %>%
  mutate(
    outcome = case_when(
      Shift_status %in% c("a>a", "e>e") ~ 0L,  # unchanged
      Shift_status %in% c("a>e", "e>a") ~ 1L   # changed
    ),
    log_freq = log(Token_fr + 1))

model_all <- glmer(
  outcome ~ Stem_type + TD_nonTD + log_freq + Dialect_area +
    (1 | Dialect) + (1 | Lexeme),
  data    = data_model_all,
  family  = binomial,
  control = glmerControl(
    optimizer = "bobyqa",
    optCtrl   = list(maxfun = 1e5)
  )
)

summary(model_all)   
    
```
